author: ValWood
body: * **PTHR ID & PTN node:** [PTN000032816](http://www.pantherdb.org/panther/lookupId.jsp?id=PTN000032816) GO:0010468 | regulation of gene expression GO:0051252 | regulation of RNA metabolic process * **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):** https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC23D3.08 * **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue** propagation. this is **part_of** splicing (and it doesn't have an S. cerevisiae ortholog) * Add the label 'high priority' if needed. Generally high priority issues affect a lot of proteins, and annotations are incorrect (as opposed to just imprecise).
title: PTN000032816 not all regulators

author: marcfeuermann
body: This is a huge family with over 1300 sequences. In general, I do not like terms such as 'regulation of gene expression' or 'regulation of RNA metabolic process' which are very broad. I've removed the use of these 2 terms and re-PAINTed with more granular terms when possible.
